steps: In the displacement method, the sum of object and image distances is D = 150 cm, so u + v = 150.
Using the lens formula 1/v + 1/u = 1/f, we get uv/(u+v) = f, which gives uv = 150 * 24 = 3600.
Solving the system u + v = 150 and uv = 3600 yields the quadratic equation x^2 - 150x + 3600 = 0.
The roots of this equation are x = (150 ± √(22500 - 14400))/2 = (150 ± 90)/2, giving 120 cm and 30 cm.
The two positions give magnifications m₁ = v₁/u₁ = 120/30 = 4 and m₂ = v₂/u₂ = 30/120 = 1/4.
The ratio of the sizes (linear magnifications) of the two images is m₁/m₂ = 4 / (1/4) = 16.
